We build the data centre, fit it out and run it.

NOURRA works from Singapore on AI compute infrastructure in Southeast Asia. We build our own AI data centres and use our own engineering and operations teams to rack GPU clusters and keep them running. GPU supply and cloud are verified by us and delivered alongside.

Send your requirement See what we do

We share site location, power capacity and power-on dates in writing when we talk. External GPU supply we haven’t re-checked in two weeks doesn’t get quoted.

Four places a compute deal usually gets stuck

  • GPUs without a rack, racks without power

    Servers, rack space, power and network sit with different parties. One missing piece keeps the cluster dark.

    What we doRack space and power are in our own data centre, and racking and operations are our own teams. One party owns the schedule.

  • Work subcontracted until nobody is accountable

    The main contractor passes it down, the subcontractor hires day labour, and no one can vouch for quality or dates.

    What we doOur own engineering team does the works and the racking. The plan names who is responsible for each item.

  • Racked, then left alone

    Everything works on handover day. After that, inspections, faults and expansion are each someone else’s problem.

    What we doThe same team stays on for operations, with response times and inspections set in an SLA.

  • Plenty of GPU quotes, no way to tell which are real

    The same batch gets relayed through several people. Stock on hand, future allocations and units already sold all look alike.

    What we doWe grade external supply by how well it’s verified, quote only what we’ve checked recently, and confirm end user and use in writing first.

Four things we do, alone or joined into one deal

Our AI data centres and colocation

Who it’s forAI companies and compute operators that need high-density rack space, and partners or investors in AI data centre projects in Southeast Asia.

What we do

  • Build high-density data centres for GPU clusters around Singapore
  • Provide rack space, power and cooling, including colocation for your own hardware
  • When our own capacity is booked, source partner sites whose power and permits we have checked

What you get

Written rack and power details, with power-on dates and billing start.

Data centre fit-out subcontracting

Who it’s forData centre owners, main contractors and hardware owners that need a dependable local crew.

What we do

  • Electrical, low-voltage and security works
  • Server racking, cabling and data centre relocation
  • Join a main contractor’s project as subcontractor and deliver to drawings and milestones
  • For high-density liquid cooling and GPU cluster networking we assign specialist engineers per project and name who is responsible

What you get

An itemised scope, schedule and acceptance criteria.

On-site operations

Who it’s forData centre owners and compute customers whose hardware is racked and needs long-term care.

What we do

  • On-site staffing, routine inspections and fault handling
  • Hardware replacement, expansion and migration
  • Reporting against an agreed SLA

What you get

An operations SLA stating response times, inspection scope and reporting.

GPU compute and enterprise cloud

Who it’s forTeams that need whole servers or clusters, and companies with significant monthly cloud spend, deployed outside mainland China.

What we do

  • Match lease or purchase supply to your model, quantity and term, and verify whether it is on hand or a future allocation
  • Hardware goes straight into our data centre for racking, with no hand-offs in between
  • Enterprise accounts, discounts and model APIs on major public clouds through authorised resellers
  • Cloud and model services are for a company’s own normal usage, only where their providers support them

What you get

A written quote stating supply status, commercial terms, delivery date and validity.

From first conversation to a running cluster

  1. Describe the requirement

    Model or compute size, quantity, location, target go-live date, lease or buy.

  2. Confirm end user and use

    Written confirmation of who will use it, where, and for what. If this step fails, we stop here.

  3. Plan and resources

    We settle rack space, power, works scope and operations. External supply is verified item by item before it goes into the plan.

  4. Quote and way of working

    A written quote with validity, delivery conditions, and whether it is full delivery or a single scope.

  5. Sign and deliver

    Arrival, racking, commissioning and power-on, accepted against contract milestones.

  6. Operate and renew

    Operations under the SLA. Before the term ends we agree renewal, expansion or exit.

Our own teams, and the rules we apply to every deal

We don’t yet have client work we can name publicly. This is how we work, and you can check each point as we go.

External supply gets one of four grades. Only the top two are quoted

  1. HearsayNever quoted
  2. VerbalNever quoted
  3. Written quoteQuoted to clients
  4. Seen or confirmedQuoted to clients

Any resource not re-checked within two weeks drops out of our quotes.

  • Our own teams

    Site, fit-out and operations are done by our own people. The plan names who is responsible for each item.

  • Compliance first

    For GPU requests we confirm end user, location and use in writing before discussing supply.

  • In writing

    Scope, delivery dates and what happens on non-delivery go into the quote and the contract.

What we don’t do

  • Supply or tranship to countries, regions or end users restricted by export controls
  • Act as a nominee buyer or contracting party on someone else’s behalf
  • Quote supply we haven’t verified
  • Support model distillation, resale of personal subscriptions, or gambling businesses

Questions we hear often

Are the data centres NOURRA’s own?

We are building our own AI data centres and also source rack space at partner sites. We share location, power capacity and power-on dates in writing when we talk.

Do you do the fit-out and operations yourselves, or pass them on?

Our own engineering and operations teams do the work. For specialist items such as high-density liquid cooling and GPU cluster networking we assign specialist engineers per project and name who is responsible.

Does NOURRA own the GPUs?

GPU hardware comes from suppliers we have verified, or you bring your own. We verify supply, coordinate terms, and rack and operate the hardware in our data centre.

How long until we’re live?

It depends on when the rack space powers on and whether supply is on hand or a future allocation. The quote gives a date for each stage. We don’t make blanket promises.

Why are there no prices on this site?

Rack space, works and GPU prices all move with scale, term and the market. We quote in writing against your conditions, with a validity date.

Can equipment be shipped to mainland China or other controlled destinations?

No. We only serve requirements used lawfully in permitted locations, and we confirm end user and location in writing.

Tell us what you’re building or housing

Give us rack count or compute size, power needs, location and target go-live date. That’s what lets us say quickly whether and how we can do it.
